'''Teak''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] employed by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] at their [[CZ-198]] research facility, where [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Teak worked on the [[Vigilant]] security system&mdash;a genetically-modified [[Flesh Raider]] integrated with the electronic security of the facility. Teak was considered expendable by Special Executive [[Rasmus Blys]], who suggested to Doctor Kisadran that Teak be assigned to direct interaction with the Vigilant after it killed a number of maintenance staff.<ref name="Log" />
